appClientId._comment: Application (client) ID from the app registration's Overview page.

servicePrincipalObjectId._comment: OBJECT ID of the app's SERVICE PRINCIPAL - NOT the app's object id and NOT the client id. Find it: Entra > Enterprise applications > (your app) > Overview > Object ID. Or: az ad sp show --id <appClientId> --query id -o tsv

runbookContentUri._comment: Raw, publicly reachable URL of ztassessment-runbook-cert.ps1 (e.g. raw.githubusercontent.com URL, or a blob URL with SAS token).

vmSetupScriptUri._comment: Raw, publicly reachable URL of vm-setup.ps1 - the VM extension downloads and runs it.

orchestratorContentUri._comment: Raw URL of ztassessment-orchestrator.ps1. This is the runbook the SCHEDULE calls: it starts the VM, runs the assessment on the worker, then deallocates the VM.

reportRetentionDays._comment: Blob lifecycle auto-delete. Set 0 to keep reports forever.

services._comment: Services for scheduled runs. All six pillars. Remove SharePointOnline / AipService if you don't want their extra roles and permissions.

scheduleStartTime._comment: First scheduled run. ISO 8601 with offset, MUST be more than 5 minutes in the future at deploy time or the deployment fails.

certificateSubject._comment: Optionally include the customer name, e.g. CN=ZeroTrustAssessment-Contoso

vmSize._comment: D4s_v5 (4 vCPU / 16 GB) is comfortable; D2s_v5 suffices for small tenants.

vmAdminPassword._comment: Do NOT store a real password in this file. Pass at deploy time: --parameters vmAdminPassword=<value>, or reference a Key Vault secret here instead.

baseTags._comment: Applied to ALL resources (the lighter five). Fill in real values - tag-value policies often reject empty strings.

vmExtraTags._comment: Merged on top of baseTags for the VM, NIC and VM extensions only - giving those resources the full ten tags.
